scheme: D 素玉篆刻（项目风格收敛前的历史探索）
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original Chinese xianxia game prop ideal concept, one complete formation disk with modular pieces installed. This is option D "素玉篆刻 / sect-carved jade formation tablet", a materially distinct exploration rather than a color variant.
Primary request: Make this feel immediately like a Chinese cultivation formation instrument carved by an array master, seen in exact 90-degree orthographic TOP VIEW, while its separate little functional parts are clearly installable components. The base is a modest thick flat SQUARE pale grey-celadon nephrite tablet, softly hand-rounded corners, no ornamental metal border. Entire silhouette visible, centered with breathing room, square composition, genuinely transparent background outside the prop.
Visual identity: restrained, austere, cultured Chinese seal-carving and talisman craftsmanship. Stone has fine cloudy mineral inclusions, softly worn matte surface, tiny chisel marks and a few very shallow intaglio seal-script-like marks that are abstract non-readable symbols. Fine low-contrast incomplete concentric ritual arcs and four discreet orientation seals are carved into the surface, giving a coherent mystical ARRAY diagram, without a grid and without making a large decorative medallion. Keep an open working area and four discrete functional pieces. No loose scrolls or other scene props.
Components: FOUR shallow sculptural stone/jade fittings, distinct silhouettes, each approximately one hidden logical cell or a two-cell strip. (1) In the upper-middle area a small square jade seal inset, incised with a compact folded talisman glyph, the array eye; it is socketed flat into a stepped stone seat. (2) At upper-left a narrow horizontal jade-marrow chamber with two dull mineral slivers held by simple stone tenons, the power source. (3) At lower-left a slender split bone-jade stylus seated in a small oval recess, the sensing piece. (4) At lower-right a tall narrow assembly of TWO overlapping carved jade leaves with a quiet arching cutout between them, the protective executor; abstract technical ritual piece, NOT a shield, not a jewelry brooch. No modern black-chip packaging, rows of pins, screw mounts, capacitors, CPU motifs or futuristic holograms.
Connections: Show a coherent small number of actual carved connection paths between the four fittings, terminating into their edge sockets. Command paths are thin deep ink-indigo incisions, like controlled seal-carving strokes with tiny vermilion punctuation marks; power paths are slightly broader shallow grooves filled with warm translucent pale honey-colored mineral light. Clear material difference and readable connected bends, not fat pipes, not gold-framed turquoise hoses. The two systems never cross, overlap or pass through unrelated components. All main paths stay within the tablet, no floating power lines. Make their careful purposeful routing feel like a small enchanted formation diagram rather than a computer motherboard. Decorative incisions much fainter than actual connections.
Rendering: polished painterly game inventory prop illustration, refined mineral/material texture, crisp readable silhouettes, compact object design suitable for an eventual icon. Flat orthographic camera, only subtle shallow bevel shading to reveal construction; NOT isometric or tilted. Restrained color and very subtle inner magic, no bloom, no oversaturated neon. No background, no cast ground shadow, no UI frame, labels, text, numbers, visible squares, checkerboard, grid, shield emblem, flags, large gold rim, dragons or luxury jewelry embellishments.
This is a fresh original image, no imitation of any existing game's exact icon or copyrighted artwork.

Draw just ONE NEW blue-black signal route from the lower-left stylus sensor to the TOP port of the lower-right leaf executor: from the sensor's LEFT edge, route a fine dark ink-indigo engraved line LEFT toward the inner-left margin, then UP along the left margin around the OUTSIDE of the upper-left mineral trough, then RIGHT through the free space above BOTH the trough and the central square seal, then DOWN through free space at the far right until it enters the TOP of the leaf executor.
